description: This Java class `DeleteCenterCommandHandler` handles delete commands for 'Center' entities within a group management module. It implements command processing to invoke service layer deletion logic and is annotated as a Spring service with transaction management.

classes.name: DeleteCenterCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles delete commands for Center entities, utilizing dependency injection for the write platform service and processing commands transactionally.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command and delegates the deletion operation to the underlying group write platform service within a transactional context.
